scientific_integrity: Analytic proof included; exhaustive code enumerates only finite orders 3 through 15 and is not presented as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to unit-weight cyclic two-approval incidence elections and standard harmonic proportional approval voting; independent external validation not performed; publication priority is subject to possible unindexed equivalent graph formulations.
title: Sharp greedy-PAV score spectrum on cyclic two-approval elections
